body:
Hi there,

I was looking at your website this week, and I spotted something you will want to fix fast: the title of your own homepage spells your name "Vison" instead of Vision. Right under it, every service you offer, design, turf, irrigation, hardscapes, cleanups, is squeezed into one long run-on paragraph, so a customer has to dig to figure out what you actually do.

That is a shame, because a company serving Kingman since 1997 should be easy to find and easy to call.

So I redesigned your homepage, and it is attached to this email as a PDF. Your services each get their own clear section, your 25 plus years in Kingman sit right at the top, and your phone number stays in front of the visitor the whole way down the page.

Landscaping sites are a big part of my work. I built the website for NH Landscape Garden (nhlandscapegarden.com), a landscaping company that needed its services laid out clearly for homeowners. I also built Straight Edge ATX (straightedgeatx.com), a landscaping site for an Austin company designed around fast quote requests.

If you like the redesign, I can put it on your real domain and build out the rest of your pages. If not, keep the PDF as free ideas, no hard feelings either way.

Best,
Hassan
name: Vision Landscape & Design LLC
subject: 🌵 Your own homepage spells your name 'Vison'
